_comment: UNSPSC segment (first 2 digits) -> readable Spanish category name. This is the CANONICAL taxonomy SECOP tags every process with via codigo_principal_de_categoria (format 'V1.NNNNNNNN'). segment_code = first 2 digits, family_code = first 4. Segment is the top-level 'category'. Edit only to fix a name; codes are the international UNSPSC standard.
